stocks.name: Portra 400
stocks.developerNotes: C-41 reference: start around 3:15 at 38 C. Use your lab or chemistry sheet as the final source of truth.
stocks.description: Flexible daylight-balanced color negative stock with wide latitude for portraits and travel.

stocks.name: Gold 200
stocks.developerNotes: C-41 consumer stock. Keep notes about your lab, scanning preference and preferred overexposure here.
stocks.description: Warm consumer color negative stock that suits daylight snapshots and everyday work.

stocks.name: Tri-X 400
stocks.developerNotes: Classic B&W stock often paired with D-76, XTOL or HC-110. Save your preferred agitation and dilution notes here.
stocks.description: Punchy black-and-white negative stock with strong character and broad exposure latitude.

stocks.name: HP5 Plus 400
stocks.developerNotes: HP5+ is commonly pushed. Add your chosen developer, dilution and agitation pattern for each push level.
stocks.description: Versatile black-and-white stock that tolerates mixed light and routine pushing well.

stocks.name: Delta 100
stocks.developerNotes: Fine-grain B&W stock. Save your high-acutance or fine-grain developer choice and contrast notes here.
stocks.description: Clean, fine-grain black-and-white stock suited to tripod work and detail-rich scenes.

stocks.name: Velvia 50
stocks.developerNotes: Slide stock with tight latitude. Record any filter, reciprocity and scanning adjustments with care.
stocks.description: Highly saturated slide film favored for landscape work and careful tripod exposures.

stocks.name: Ektachrome E100
stocks.developerNotes: E-6 workflow stock. Keep notes about scanning, color balance and any long-exposure bracket habit here.
stocks.description: Neutral slide stock that balances fine grain with practical saturation.

stocks.name: Color i-Type
stocks.developerNotes: Instant chemistry varies with temperature. Save your warm-up and shielding notes rather than a strict timer.
stocks.description: Integral instant film with built-in chemistry and an exposure workflow that depends heavily on temperature.
